# form.addExpansionPanel

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.4.0</span></div>

Add an Expansion Panel to the current form.

```lua
form.addExpansionPanel(text)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | the displayed text |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
panel = form.addExpansionPanel("Label")
panel:addLine("Label")
panel:open(false) -- by default the panel is open, let's keep it closed!
```

## Used in

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
- [widget-jet](../../examples/official/widget-jet.md)
